name: Atexxo Zone 2 iPhone 17 Pro Max
summary: The Atexxo Zone 2 iPhone 17 Pro Max is a standard Apple iPhone 17 Pro Max converted by Atexxo for hazardous areas, certified for Zone 2/22 under ATEX. It combines increased safety and intrinsic safety (Ex ec ic). The phone runs iOS 27.
imageAlt: Atexxo Zone 2 iPhone 17 Pro Max, front view

atex.marking: II 3G Ex ec ic IIC T4 Gc / II 3D Ex tc IIIB T135°C Dc
atex.scope: Unit assessment: each unit is checked by a notified body. No certificate number is published.

certification.protection: Increased safety and intrinsic safety (Ex ec ic)

safety.conditions: Charge in safe area (wired USB-C or wireless). Each unit spark-tested for intrinsically safe circuits (according to the maker's flyer).

os.name: iOS
os.updates: Security updates for 7+ years (based on previous model support)

specs.camera: 48 MP Fusion main + 48 MP ultra wide + 48 MP telephoto (4x; 8x optical-quality)
specs.video: 4K120 Dolby Vision; ProRes RAW; Apple Log 2
specs.batteryLife: Up to 37 hours of video playback
specs.nfc: Yes (Apple Pay + Core NFC tag reading)
specs.gnss: GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, QZSS, BeiDou, NavIC
specs.keys: Action Button; Camera Control; side; volume
specs.satellite: Emergency SOS + Roadside Assistance via satellite (region-dependent)

throughCase.label: USB-C / Lightning port
throughCase.value: Wired charging via housing (USB-C; Lightning on iPhone 14 models)

capabilities.value: Via app (Push to Talk framework); Action Button mappable if accessible

unconfirmed.os.securityUntil: Apple doesn't publish an end date; its legal minimum is five years from first sale. Previous iPhone models have had security updates for seven years or more.
unconfirmed.specs.batteryLife: UK model (nano-SIM and eSIM). The US eSIM-only model has a larger battery.
unconfirmed.specs.satellite: Listed on Apple's tech specs; availability depends on the country.

strengths: Security updates for 7+ years (based on previous model support)
A standard Apple iPhone 17 Pro Max inside, with the same apps and Apple device management as other iPhones
limitations: Zone 2 only, so not for Zone 1 areas
T4 temperature class: fine for most gases, but not those that ignite below 135 °C
Dust group IIIB: not rated for conductive dust
Certified by ATEX unit assessment; no certificate number is published
